reportTemplate.summary: Entered edit mode, opened the refresh interval dropdown (showing "Off"), selected "1m" ({{v9}}). Opened the Save dialog, checked the "Update default refresh value" checkbox (which enabled the Save button with 1 change), and saved — the "{{v8}}" alert appeared. Reloaded the dashboard fresh at http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/{{v4}} with no query parameters: the refresh interval selector in the top bar shows exactly "1m" and the time picker shows "{{v7}}", confirming both the refresh interval and time range defaults were persisted.

provenance.instruction: On the open dashboard 'fwgr22-n1 Bench Dashboard' (http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/afx327ia3kx6oc/fwgr22-n1-bench-dashboard), set the dashboard's auto-refresh interval to '1m' (1 minute): open the refresh interval dropdown/selector in the top bar next to the time picker (it may currently show 'Off' or a value), and select '1m' from the list. Then SAVE the dashboard so the refresh interval persists - when saving, tick the 'Update default time range' checkbox if present so the time range (Last 6 hours) remains saved too, and confirm the 'Dashboard saved' alert appears. Then RELOAD the dashboard fresh at http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/afx327ia3kx6oc with no query parameters and report what the refresh interval selector shows in the top bar (exact label) after the reload.
